title: I've been testing automated funded accounts and so far, I'm honestly impressed
author: TrueRead1435
selftext:
I've been exploring automated trading lately and decided to try an automated funded account myself.

For anyone unfamiliar with the model, the idea is pretty simple: you put up collateral to activate a larger funded account, but instead of manually trading it, a curated strategy executes the trades automatically.

For example, accounts has:

* $100 collateral
* $500 account size
* $100 drawdown limit
* 20% profit target ($100)
* 70% profit share, meaning the first cashout would be $70

https://preview.redd.it/oewdcr7rxalh1.png?width=1237&format=png&auto=webp&s=b3b1f062ebfa05ade689d5038bb8cebf57c98094

I'm currently testing several automated journeys, and so far they're doing really well:

* $10 testing account — already promoted once
* $500 → $521.94
* $500 → $564.31

The $500 account in the first screenshot is currently at **+$64.56 (+12.91%)**, so it's already more than halfway toward the $100 profit target.

https://preview.redd.it/y2ea23dwxalh1.png?width=764&format=png&auto=webp&s=8861a271a6414185efe7e7ad4a26335fb798b673

There's also already an automated account that has reached **GOLD level**, with **$2,864 combined between cashouts and trading equity** from a **$500 initial deposit — a 572% return**.

Another thing I find really interesting about the model is the infrastructure behind it:

* Trades are executed on **Hyperliquid**
* Everything is **on-chain**
* **Automatic payouts** when profit targets are reached
* **No KYC**
* The automated strategy handles the trading rather than the user manually executing positions

The broader beta numbers are also pretty interesting:

* **$1.1B+ total volume traded**
* **1.3M+ trades executed**
* **78% automated pass rate**
* **13.9% manual pass rate**

During the beta, they also reported **250+ accounts live**, with **95%+ in profit** and **60+ payouts** already made.

Obviously, it's still early and I don't think a good run is enough to prove long-term performance. But as a user testing it myself, **so far it's going really well**.

What I find most interesting isn't even just the returns, but the model itself: automated execution, on-chain trading, automatic payouts and no KYC.

For people here who trade with bots, algorithms or AI:

**Would you trust a curated automated strategy with a funded account, or would you always prefer having full control over your own strategy?**

comments.author: Accurate_Citron_774
comments.body: How does it work (how do they earn)? E.g. prop firms earn from you breaching accounts.

replies.author: TrueRead1435
replies.body:
I'd recommend reading the whitepaper for the full breakdown, but basically the model is based on fees and a share of the profits rather than making money when traders lose.

For FUNDED accounts, traders keep **70% of the profits**, while **30% goes back to the protocol**. Part of that is used to reinvest in the ecosystem/token (with **96% of the token supply locked**).

So it's a different model from a traditional prop firm where the business can benefit when traders breach their accounts.
